reviewScope: One fidelity and retained-assessment applicability review of the five supplied whole tasks; no new numeric assessment.

rows.rationale: Only the labels a, b and c were added to the existing drawing, tree and length response parts. The table, network scaffolds, minimum-spanning-tree demand and answers including 1015 km are unchanged.

The original map image shows the same eight labelled states and territories and border relationships described by the old semantic map: WA–NT, WA–SA, NT–SA, NT–QLD, QLD–SA, QLD–NSW, SA–NSW, SA–Victoria, NSW–Victoria and NSW–ACT; Tasmania is isolated. The separate lettered network, questions and answers (ACT degree 1 and Queensland A) are unchanged. The visual substitution and part labels preserve the assessed task; this is a semantic comparison, not pixel equivalence.

The weighted network, drawing task, question asking for its mathematical term, and answer minimum spanning tree remain unchanged. The former cloze carried that answer as hidden answer data; the replacement break contains no answer text, so it does not reveal the term or change the requested reasoning. The labels and paragraph formatting change presentation; rendering and available writing space were outside this review.
Only a and b labels were added to the existing path and weight response parts. The weighted network, A-to-J shortest-path demand, path A–B–E–F–J and weight 15 remain unchanged.
Only a and b labels were added to the existing network-drawing and shortest-time parts. The travelling-time table, eight-road network demand, A-to-E question and 62-minute answer remain unchanged.
